text:
alice: Heads-up — pagerlink alerts stopped paging on-call around 08:12 UTC. I see ~40 alerts queued in alert-queue. :eyes:
incbot: [AUTOMATION] paging suppressed: webhook returned 403 (invalid-signature). queued=40 reason=signature-mismatch
ben: Oof. Can someone grab the runbook? /cc @jamie-oncall
carla: Runbook: https://go/runbooks/pagerlink-integration
carla: Quick check: looks like the PAGERLINK_SECRET in prod-monitoring-1 is empty on the cluster we use for the webhook proxy
ben: Can someone run and paste (redact creds):
```
kubectl -n infra get secret pagerlink-secret -o yaml
```
alice: Pulled recent ingress logs, sample: ```POST /webhook 403 {"error":"invalid-signature","expected":"sha256=abcd...","received":"sha256=ef01..."}```
ops-bot: Deploy event detected: incident-bot rollout at 08:27 UTC (initiated by ben)
ben: I'm going to restart incident-bot to clear any cached key: ``kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/incident-bot``
jamie-oncall: Acknowledged. Manual paging started (phone ringdown) while we triage. I'm taking incident ops until resolved.
dinesh: CX impact: ticket #9876 — customers reported /v1/generate timeouts 08:05–08:30, rough impact ~3% of requests. CS notified, capturing request ids.
carla: After restart, incbot log: ```incbot: forwarding queued pages -> success to jamie-oncall (42 messages) at 08:29```
incbot: [AUTOMATION] suppressed pages drained and forwarded (42 pages).
ben: Root cause appears to be the nightly key rotation job failing to write the new secret into prod-monitoring-1; CI job didn't surface the failure. Filing INFRA-2345.
alice: Action item: add alert for >5 webhook-signature failures/min so pages don't silently queue. Small infra ticket?
jamie-oncall: I'll stay on until 09:00 to confirm no regressions. :coffee:
ben: Patching CI to surface secret write errors and adding a one-time migration script to ensure all clusters have the rotated key. Deploying canary now.
carla: Status page updated with initial customer notification: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/9876
dinesh: Summary for postmortem: impact window 08:05–08:29, pages queued but delivered at 08:29 after manual restart. Customers saw elevated timeouts during window.
alice: Thanks everyone — postmortem assigned to ben, due EOD tomorrow. Please add notes to INFRA-2345 and include timeline + logs.
ben: ack :thumbsup:
